title: Towards Real-world Debiasing: Rethinking Evaluation, Challenge, and Solution
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical challenges of debiasing machine learning models in vision and NLP. While it uses datasets like CivilComments-WILDS that include religious identity as a demographic attribute, the paper's core objective is the development and evaluation of a debiasing framework (RDBench) and a specific technical method (DiD), rather than evaluating religious or ethical systems themselves.
